title: Models survive rewriting in 8-bit integers
body: Post-training quantization converts 32-bit weights to 8-bit integers, shrinking a model roughly fourfold with often minor accuracy loss, because weight distributions tolerate coarse rounding surprisingly well. Phones running local models exist thanks to this arithmetic diet. Precision in ML is a budget, and most bits were buying almost nothing.
source_hint: Jacob et al. (2018), quantization for inference
